claim_scores.rationale: It patches `sys.modules` for `sglang` and mocks `get_free_port`, `wait_for_server`, `subprocess.Popen`, and `threading.Thread` with a fake process, so no real server is started.
It starts from `openai/huggingface/my-org/my-model`, pulls the `--model-path` value from the captured command, and asserts it is exactly `my-org/my-model`.
It captures the actual `Popen` argv list as `command` and prints that exact list, exposing the list-form `python -m sglang.launch_server` launch command with `--model-path`, `--port`, and `--host`.
It asserts the post-launch `lm.kwargs['api_key']` is the literal string `local`.
